title: [29.x][Subscription Billing] 1M 'Align to End of Month' line with end date produces a 1-day prorated stub
summary: Fixed a billing period calculation issue in Subscription Billing where monthly billing with 'Align to End of Month' would create an unintended one-day prorated stub when the subscription line ended within the period.
key_points: CalculateNextToDate now correctly caps the period end date at the Subscription Line End Date
Prevents one-day prorated billing lines when the end date falls within a monthly period
Affects vendor contracts using 1M billing rhythm with month-end alignment
Adds test coverage for the corrected behavior
quote: Updated CalculateNextToDate to cap the calculated period end date at the Subscription Line End Date when it falls within the current monthly period.
